description: Static game tile style for opaque/full-bleed terrain, floor, wall, and world tiles.

prompt_blocks.house_style: High-quality top-down or orthographic game-art tile. Full-bleed 256x256 composition, no margins, no labels, no UI, no icon border, no isolated sticker silhouette. The image should read as one usable map tile, not as a framed illustration.
prompt_blocks.user_style_notes_join: Apply these style notes consistently across every tile in the pack: {user_style_notes}.
